source.title: Subsistence Procurement and Production after the Demise of Teotihuacan
source.inspection: main article PDF pages 1–9; supplemental data not inspected

findings.claim: More than 1680 sediment samples from quarry tunnels analyzed at UNAM 1994–1997
Selected silo botanical counts Varillas Chenopodium 8642 Amaranthus 56 maize 66 other 50; Pirul 212, 10, 5, 70 respectively
Chenopodium berlandieri achenes generally nondomesticated morphology; cultivation versus foraging unresolved
Coyotlatelco Varillas chenopods in silos hearths burials; maize amaranth purslane chia beans in silos/hearths but not burials
Two-sample KS maximum cumulative difference 0.26668 exceeds stated critical values 0.08023 and 0.11504
